title: Jahowa, Jahowa
chord: Am · G · C · D · Em · Am · D7 · A
lyrics:
Na marmahani hita Parholong roha i
I ma Tuhanta Jesus Silehon tua i, Silehon tua i
Ditatap pardangolan Ni manisia i
Soada hasonangan Na lilu do sude, Na lilu do sude
Alai ro ma Ibana Tu hasiangan on
Manobus huriaNa Humophop hita on, Humophop hita on

Dirina dipasahat Tu hamatean i
Ibana gabe singkat Ni manisia i, Ni manisia i
Dibahen i, o jolma Naung sae do dosami
Ai molo ho porsea Taruli ho disi, Taruli ho disi
Antong hamu na loja Binaen ni dosa i
Sai ro hamu sudena Tu Tuhan Jesus i, Tu Tuhan Jesus i

Sai naeng pasonangonNa Hamuna sasude
Sai naeng togihononNa Hamu tu Surgo i, Hamu tu Surgo i
